summary: Resolves and validates a locale from language/region strings. Lazily initializes a locale-info function pointer dword_8D3FB8 based on OS (GetLocaleInfoA on NT via WindowsNTCheck, sub_5904F7 otherwise). Binary-searches the language string a1 and the region string a1+64 against the 64-entry table off_5E72D0 and the 22-entry table off_5E7218, updates validation state dword_8D3FB0, runs one of four resolution helpers, then if validation succeeded obtains a code page via sub_5903DA, validates it with IsValidCodePage and IsValidLocale, fills the output words a2 with locale id, language id and code page, and optionally writes localized strings (a3, a3+64) via the locale-info function plus a Base10NegativeSpecialCase string conversion. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

operations.description: Lazily initialize the locale-info function pointer dword_8D3FB8: on first call select GetLocaleInfoA when WindowsNTCheck() reports NT, otherwise sub_5904F7.
Guard on a1 non-null; a null a1 jumps directly to the fallback resolution path.
Store the language string pointer: dword_8D3FA8 = (int)a1.
If the language string is non-empty, binary-search it in the 64-entry 8-byte record table off_5E72D0, updating dword_8D3FA8 to the matched record.
Advance to the region string: v3 = a1 + 64; dword_8D3FAC = (int)(a1 + 64).
If a1 is not the -64 boundary sentinel and the region string is non-empty, binary-search it in the 22-entry 8-byte record table off_5E7218, updating dword_8D3FAC to the matched record.
Branch on language match result: if no language matched, run sub_590303 when a region is present or sub_5903C0 otherwise (fallback path).
If a language matched: run sub_58FF65 when a region is present, otherwise sub_5901F0.
If validation state dword_8D3FB0 is non-zero, obtain the code page v4 = sub_5903DA(a1 + 128).
Validate the resolved values: require v4 non-zero, IsValidCodePage((unsigned __int16)v4) and IsValidLocale(Locale, 1).
If output a2 is non-null, write the resolution results: a2[0] = Locale, a2[1] = dword_8D3FB4, a2[2] = v4 (code page).
If the string buffer a3 is null, success is complete: return 1.

Fetch localized strings via the locale-info function pointer: dword_8D3FB8(Locale, 4097, a3, 64) and dword_8D3FB8(dword_8D3FB4, 4098, a3 + 64, 64); on success convert the code page via Base10NegativeSpecialCase(v4, a3 + 128, 10) and return 1.
All failure paths converge on return 0.

clean_pseudocode: if (a2) { a2[0] = Locale; a2[1] = dword_8D3FB4; a2[2] = v4; }
unresolved: Meaning of the validation flags in dword_8D3FB0 and the exact semantics of the four resolution helpers sub_590303, sub_5903C0, sub_58FF65, sub_5901F0 is not established here.
Global dword_8D3FB4 (written into a2[1]) is read but its role as a language id is DERIVED from the fill, not proven.
The 8-byte record layouts of off_5E72D0 (64 entries) and off_5E7218 (22 entries) are not recovered.
